Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Duncan Robinson?

Duncan Robinson is 32 years old.

Where was Duncan Robinson born?

Duncan Robinson was born in York, Maine.

When was Duncan Robinson born?

Duncan Robinson was born on April 22, 1994.

How tall is Duncan Robinson?

Duncan Robinson is 6-7 (201 cm) tall.

How much does Duncan Robinson weigh?

Duncan Robinson weighs 215 lbs (97 kg).

Is Duncan Robinson in the Hall of Fame?

Duncan Robinson is not in the Hall of Fame.

What position does Duncan Robinson play?

Small Forward and Shooting Guard.

What is Duncan Robinson's net worth?

Duncan Robinson has made at least $89,946,879 playing professional basketball.

How much does Duncan Robinson make?

Duncan Robinson made $19,406,000 in 2025.

How many rings does Duncan Robinson have?

Duncan Robinson has won 0 championships.

What is Duncan Robinson's Instagram account?

Duncan Robinson is on Instagram at d_bo20.

What schools did Duncan Robinson attend?

Duncan Robinson attended Phillips Exeter Academy in Exeter, New Hampshire, Williams and Michigan.

What are Duncan Robinson's nicknames?

Dunc, Jimmy Neutron, Sheen are nicknames for Duncan Robinson.
